Jamesina Watterly is a named Grand Master Engineering trainer in Northrend.
Sally Tompkins is a named Grand Master First Aid trainer in Northrend.
Angelina Soren is a named Grand Master Fishing trainer in Northrend.
Marjory Kains is a named Grand Master Herbalism trainer in Northrend.
Booker Kells is a Grand Master Inscription trainer who offers instruction and goods for browsing.

Carter Tiffens is a Grand Master Jewelcrafting trainer in Vengeance Landing. He describes years spent learning to cut gems into perfect form and frustration that his skills are going to waste in this wretched place. He asks for Northrend gems, offering to teach a technique that can sometimes produce stronger versions of uncommon gems.
Gunter Hansen is a Grand Master leatherworking trainer in Northrend.
Jonathan Lewis is a Grand Master mining trainer in Northrend.
Roberta Jacks is a Grand Master skinning trainer in Northrend.
Alexandra McQueen is a Grand Master tailoring trainer in Northrend. She offers to teach Cloth Scavenging for additional Frostweave from slain Northrend humanoids.
Stephan Franks is a reagent supplies vendor in Northrend. He offers goods for browsing.
Noatak is a fishmonger in Northrend. His vendor service offers goods for browsing.
Tipvigut is a general-goods vendor.
Uukkarnit is a trade-goods vendor.

Caregiver Iqniq is an innkeeper who shows both welcome and wariness: one invites guests to rest by the fire and mentions the smell of fish, while another eyes a visitor suspiciously and warns them not to stay long because they do not understand her people and she wants no trouble.
Arrluk is a vendor of poison and reagents.
Trapper Shesh is a stable master.
Deniigi is a spearcrafter who sells goods and offers repairs, combining a specialist craft identity with practical equipment services.
A spearman of Kamagua, part of the settlement’s armed presence in Howling Fjord.
A named bat handler who offers travelers fast transport. When attacked, Adeline cries “Guards!” and summons an enraged felbat.
A Gjalerhorn scavenger who searches the surrounding area for what can be salvaged.
A Gjalerhorn worker, part of the site’s laboring population alongside others with the same designation.

Ranger Captain Areiel seeks to weaken Nifflevar before reinforcements from Vengeance Landing arrive, asking the adventurer to attack its Dragonflayer defenders. On their return, she greets and praises them, saying the arriving force can handle any remaining vrykul.

Thorvald is identified as Halgrind's chieftain and a Dragonflayer patriarch. After the Forsaken took the village, he fled west. Chief Plaguebringer Harris considers his blood useful for tailoring a plague strain to vrykul biology.
Dragonflayer Guardian is a humanoid guard encountered in Halgrind. Several guardians there make them a visible part of the area's Dragonflayer presence.
Emilune Winterwind is a flight-master assistant who can arrange gryphon travel to Westguard Keep. Her recorded greeting asks Elune to watch over the traveler.

Alanya is identified as "Silvermoon" Harry's companion and helps arrange passage on his bomber toward Bael'gun's. In a recorded line, she complains that she must keep a mask on for Harry to speak with her, revealing strain in their relationship.

A Vrykul Harpoon Gun operates as a siege weapon in attacks on Vrykul facilities. Its reports describe a destroyed longhouse, a direct hit on the Dockhouse, and the Vrykul Storage facility burning, with defenders alerted.
A gryphon associated with the Westguard forces.
A Westguard bombardier associated with Westguard forces.
Kip Trawlskip is a named flight master who handles fast travel.
Harry's Bomber is a transport associated with Harry. Its engine rumbles loudly.

Apothecary Scyllis belongs to the Royal Apothecary Society. Addressing a Longrunner, she describes people as a resource for use against the vrykul, briefly calling them “fodder” before correcting herself to “ally.” Her wording exposes a cynical, instrumental view beneath the diplomatic correction.

Longrunner Nanik is a Taunka envoy sent by Camp Winterhoof's chieftain to seek allies against the vrykul. He describes the assaults as a threat his people cannot withstand alone and appeals for help, making him a direct voice for the village's urgent need.
Scout Knowles's Mount is a beast associated with the scout named in its title. Its identity is defined by that relationship rather than by a separate personal name.
Fjord penguins are small Northrend animals found across multiple areas of the fjord region, representing local wildlife rather than a single named individual.
Cricket is a named beast associated with a single local appearance in Dragonblight. Its individual name sets it apart from the region's broader wildlife population.

Magister Varenthas is a Kirin Tor magister who describes Dalaran's move to Northrend and offers a magical route to the city. His signet serves as proof for Archmage Celindra, whom travelers are directed to seek after arriving above Crystalsong Forest.
Deathguard Hemil is a humanoid in Howling Fjord.
King Ymiron is an elite who casts Ethereal Teleport.
Jason Morris is a humanoid in Howling Fjord.
Julian Morris is a humanoid in Howling Fjord.
Jessica Morris is a humanoid in Howling Fjord.
Nicole Morris is a humanoid in Howling Fjord.
A Forsaken recruit in Howling Fjord.
A Shoveltusk Forager is a level 69 Shoveltusk. It charges when a creature draws its aggression and uses Gore in combat.
A Tamed Shoveltusk is a tamed Shoveltusk. It uses Head Butt in combat.
A Wild Shoveltusk is a level 68 Shoveltusk found in the area. It uses Head Butt in combat.
The Lion Seal Whelp is a young lion seal found in the area.
Chelsea Reese is a stable master who welcomes visitors and offers help with stabling pets and recovering lost companions. Her role centers on caring for adventurers’ animal companions.
Beau is Chelsea Reese’s horse, a named animal associated with the stablemaster.
Foxy is Chelsea's dog.

An Unknown Voice is a disembodied presence heard across several Northrend areas. When struck by the Whisper Gulch spell effect, it warns that danger is coming, urges its listeners to give in to fear, and tells them to kill before being killed.
The Kamagua Turtle Rider is associated with the settlement of Kamagua. Its name identifies its role as a turtle rider.
Nikita is identified as Jessica Morris's companion.
Billie is identified as Nicole Morris's companion.
Tanaika is a Kalu'ak quartermaster in Kamagua who offers goods for sale.
Perobas the Bloodthirster is a named elite fighter in the Borean Tundra. In combat, he uses Gnaw Bone and, when badly wounded, Tendon Rip.
Vigdis the War Maiden is a named elite combatant encountered in the Borean Tundra.
King Ping is a named beast in the Borean Tundra whose attacks include Belly Flop and Flipper Thwack.
The Valgarde Captive suffers under a Dragonflayer Rune-Seer. When struck by Incinerate, the captive cries out, writhes in pain, then collapses and feigns death.
Logistics Officer Brighton serves as the Alliance Vanguard quartermaster in the Borean Tundra, offering goods for browsing.
Sebastian Crane serves as the Horde Expedition quartermaster in the Borean Tundra, offering goods for browsing.

The Howling Fjord Flame Warden tends the Alliance festival flame in the Fjord. The Warden encourages visitors to honor Alliance fires and urges them to desecrate Horde flames, reflecting the rivalry between the two celebrations.

The Howling Fjord Flame Keeper tends the Horde festival flame in the Fjord. The Keeper encourages visitors to honor Horde fires and urges them to desecrate Alliance flames, reflecting the rivalry between the two celebrations.
Jennifer Owings serves food and drink and offers goods to browse. She is found in the Howling Fjord.
Megan Owings is a bartender who offers goods to browse. She is found in the Howling Fjord.

The Maiden of Winter's Breath Lake speaks as someone freed from a curse and asks a mortal to take a blade that has brought her ill. Her words identify her as the blade's former bearer, though they do not explain the curse or its origin.

place_records.text: You are in Howling Fjord, a cold, contested land in Northrend. The Alliance holds Valgarde and Westguard Keep, the Horde holds New Agamand, Vengeance Landing and Camp Winterhoof, and the tuskarr of Kamagua belong to neither side. Dragonflayer vrykul are the main danger, and Northsea pirates work out of Scalawag Point.

You are in Daggercap Bay, a bay of shipwrecks on the Howling Fjord coast. Alliance salvagers search the wrecks for Valgarde's lost supplies, with Harold Lagras working the bottom of the bay. Dockmaster Basil Crowe sends the Northspear, a steam icebreaker, from here to Menethil Harbor, and Daggercap hammerheads and Dragonflayer raiders trouble the water.

You are in Valgarde, the Alliance port in Howling Fjord. Vice Admiral Keller holds it as the Alliance's supply line into Northrend, and he presses for help against the Dragonflayer attackers and for the rescue of captured townsfolk. Cooks, tailors and jewelcrafters teach their crafts here, and Thoralius the Wise, too old to travel, sends others into the spirit world.

You are in Wyrmskull Village, a ruin in Howling Fjord that the vrykul have taken over. Scout Valory and Defender Mordun hold what remains of the Valgarde guard against Dragonflayer thanes, fleshrippers and val'kyr watchers. Captured Valgarde citizens are still held in cages nearby.

You are in Nifflevar, a vrykul village on the bluffs above Howling Fjord. Dragonflayer warriors, rune-seers and hunting hounds, along with the Ancient Citizens of Nifflevar, are the dangers here. A Valgarde captive suffers under a Dragonflayer rune-seer.

You are in the Isle of Spears, a wild island off Howling Fjord. Frostwing chimaeras and spearfang worgs roam it, and the restless dead of Northsea pirates linger here, including the ghost of Black Conrad.

You are in Kamagua, a tuskarr village in Howling Fjord that belongs to neither side. Elder Atuik leads the Kalu'ak here, and he is arming his people against the Northsea slavers who raided Iskaal. Anuniaq worries that pirates killed the alpha sea lion, Big Roy, and the sea lions will not mate.

You are in Garvan's Reef, a reef in the waters off Howling Fjord. Great reef sharks and orcas prowl the water, rabid brown bears roam the shore, and a pirate called Mad Jonah Sterling is among the trouble. Juniper books passage aboard the Sister Mercy.

You are in Scalawag Point, a pirate port in Howling Fjord run by the Northsea Freebooters. Olga the wench serves rum and ale, and Jack Adams is a hard-drinking pirate who runs up a tab. Drunken Northsea pirates, duelists and buccaneers are the dangers here.

You are in New Agamand, a Horde outpost in Howling Fjord where the Royal Apothecary Society works on plague. Chief Plaguebringer Harris tests strains adapted to the vrykul, and Plaguebringer Tillinghast experiments on proto-whelps and proto-drakes. Tobias Sarkhoff, a bat handler, offers flights from here.

You are in the Ancient Lift, a gondola that carries travelers to Kamagua. Orfus of Kamagua waits here, having come to investigate the dead rising near Shield Hill, and he warns travelers away from the danger.

You are in Halgrind, a vrykul village in Howling Fjord that the Horde has spent weeks spraying with plague. Plagued dragonflayer tribesmen, handlers and rune-casters are the dangers here, and a plagued proto-dragon has been seen.
You are in Baelgun's Excavation Site, an old dig in Howling Fjord. Iron rune workers, golems, runemasters and steelguards are the dangers here, and a rampaging earth elemental roams the site.

You are in the Explorers' League Outpost, an Alliance camp in Howling Fjord. Stanwad, a cryptographer, and Walt, an engineer building an Iron Rune Construct to fool the iron dwarves at Baelgun's, both work here, and Hidalgo the Master Falconer trains birds of prey and hunts with them. Iron dwarves are trying to bury the digs around here.

You are in Westguard Keep, an Alliance stronghold in Howling Fjord with a flight master, an inn and a stable master. Captain Adams coordinates its response to the vrykul, and Greer Orehammer runs the gryphon flights that carry urgent Alliance news. Cannoneer Ely is short of the cannonballs the keep's guns need. Winterskorn hunters, worgs and deranged explorers roam outside.

You are in Steel Gate, a dig in Howling Fjord where Alliance explorers work beside a small Horde Winterhoof hunting party. Overseer Irena Stonemantle leads the Explorers' League here, and the chief archaeologist sends pilots out in flying machines to haul relics and patrol the site. Gargoyles attack the dig, and worsening trouble in Rivenwood may force the explorers home before the work is done.

You are in Vengeance Landing, a Horde outpost in Howling Fjord with a flight master and an inn. High Executor Anselm, a Forsaken commander, leads the campaign against Arthas here and treats the Alliance as an obstacle. Apothecary Lysander is researching a plague, and Pontius keeps plaguehounds for scouting.
You are in Baleheim, a place in Howling Fjord where Winterskorn bonegrinders, skalds and spearmen roam. Bjorn Halgurdsson is also here.
You are in Skorn, a place in Howling Fjord where Winterskorn warriors, shield-maidens, tribesmen, rune-seers, woodsmen and raiders gather in large numbers.

You are in Fort Wildervar, an Alliance fort in Howling Fjord with a flight master, an inn and a smithy. Foreman Colbey's mine is blocked by a yeti, and Researcher Aderan studies the runes steering stone giants from Giants' Run. Prospector Belvar believes Iron Dwarf runes can bind and compel, and Trapper Jethan sells the meat and fur from his traps.

You are in Ivald's Ruin, a dig site in Howling Fjord where iron dwarf destroyers, laborers and sages are at work. Donny, an Explorers' League dwarf, watches from the ruin and says the iron dwarves are burying the site rather than excavating it. Shoveltusk stags roam the area.

You are in Gjalerbron, a vrykul holding in Howling Fjord. Gjalerbron warriors, necrolords and deathless watchers are about, and living sacrifices feed an awakening ritual here while captives mourn friends already taken.

You are in Camp Winterhoof, a Horde camp in Howling Fjord with a wind rider master, an inn and a stable master. Chieftain Ashtotem leads its taunka as they prepare to leave for safer lands to the north, and Longrunner Pembe studies Iron Dwarf runes. A cyclothar lurks nearby.

You are in the Ember Clutch, a Howling Fjord forest where magical fires are spreading through the woods. A guardian ancient of the proto-drake brood blames the newly awakened vrykul and their master, Skeld Drakeson, for the burning. Dragonflayer handlers and proto-drakes roam here.

You are in Derelict Strand, a Howling Fjord shore held by Alliance soldiers of the North Fleet. Captain Olster, Lieutenant Celeyne and Sergeant Lorric lead them, and Apothecary Hanes, a Royal Apothecary Society apothecary, is held captive in their camp.

You are in The Frozen Glade, a glade in Howling Fjord in Northrend. Lurielle, a sister here, reaches out to outsiders for help against the decay spreading through the glades. Ice elementals ring the glade, once companions of the sisters and now turned against them.

You are in The Vibrant Glade, a glade in Howling Fjord in Northrend. Its sisters have been driven mad by the sudden change, and the scarlet ivy they tended has been transformed into grasping vines. Chill nymphs and scarlet ivy are the dangers here.

You are in The Twisted Glade, a glade in Howling Fjord in Northrend, transformed into a hideous place where poisonous spores wither the greenery and thornvine creepers lurk among the trees and pools. Keeper Witherleaf, the most powerful of the blacksouled keepers, raises beasts from the water and soil here.

You are in Rivenwood, a wood in Howling Fjord in Northrend. Darkclaw bats, fanggore worgs, riven widows and maddened frosthorns roam it, and vrykul souls haunt its paths. In the west, Garwal, a worg, is the rival that Ulfang is trying to kill to take the alpha place of his pack.

You are in Caldemere Lake, a lake in Howling Fjord in Northrend, where Alliance fishermen from Fort Wildervar work. Frostfin, a monster with giant teeth and icicles on its fins, still lurks in the water and has nearly pulled one fisherman under. Christopher Sloan fears to fish here, and ice elementals roam the shore.
You are in Shield Hill, a hill in Howling Fjord in Northrend. Blood shades and risen vrykul ancestors roam its slopes, and Fengir the Disgraced and Windan of the Kvaldir are among the hostile ones.
You are in Cauldros Isle, an isle in Howling Fjord in Northrend. Howling wolvar trainers, shamans and lookouts hold it under their chieftain, and wild shoveltusks roam among tamed ones.

You are in Bleeding Vale, a vale in Howling Fjord in Northrend, held by Forsaken forces. Dark Ranger Lyana directs attacks on Alliance forces at the Derelict Strand, and Deathstalker Razael reports that frozen ground has left the meatwagons immobile. Wild worgs roam the vale, and a spirit healer is here.

You are in Giants' Run, a stretch of Howling Fjord in Northrend. Iron rune guardians, stonecallers, sentinels and binders roam it alongside stone giants and runed stone giants. A spirit healer is here too.

You are in Apothecary Camp, a Horde camp in Howling Fjord in Northrend. Royal apothecaries Malthus and Grick are trying to learn why Explorers' League members in Whisper Gulch have gone mad, and they disagree about the cause. The camp has a flight master, repairs and a vendor.

You are in Ember Spear Tower, an Alliance tower in Howling Fjord in Northrend. Scout Knowles watches Halgrind from an abandoned Vrykul tower, where he has seen plague tanks and an apothecary taken into the place.
You are in Shattered Straits, a stretch of Howling Fjord in Northrend. Blockade pirates, numerous here, are the main danger, along with blockade cannons.
You are in Gjalerhorn, a part of Howling Fjord. Gjalerhorn scavengers, necrolords and workers roam it in numbers, and Queen Angerboda and King Ymiron are its most dangerous hostile individuals.

You are in Frostblade Peak, part of Howling Fjord. Alliance miners from the Wildervar region are found here. Frosthorn rams, iceshard elementals, howling cyclones and icehollow behemoths make the peak dangerous.

You are in North Spear Tower, in Howling Fjord. A spirit healer here offers a return to the living for a price, cautioning that it may not yet be your time, and the choice is yours. Trapped animals are a danger here.

You are in Chillmere Coast, a shore of Howling Fjord where the Scourge is turning murlocs into mur'ghouls. Explorer Jaren, an Alliance man, hides from danger while he investigates. Old Icefin, an aged murloc, scratches symbols into the rock about his son, who was made a mur'ghoul. Servitor shades, necrotechs and mur'ghouls haunt the coast, and shielded Scourging crystals are still standing.

You are in Whisper Gulch, a keep in Howling Fjord with Westguard crossbowmen and officers among its Alliance defenders. Deranged explorers are the main danger here, with shoveltusk stags and fanggore worgs also about. Abandoned pack mules from the Explorers' League wander the keep, and a disembodied voice heard in several areas of Northrend warns of coming danger.
You are in Iskaal, part of Howling Fjord. Crazed Northsea slavers roam it in numbers, and Abdul the Insane is among its most dangerous.
You are in Thorvald's Camp, part of Howling Fjord. Shoveltusks are hunted here for their meat, and they will headbutt attackers. Dragonflayer guardians and Thorvald are the main dangers.

You are in Ghostblade Post, a Horde post in Howling Fjord. Ranger Captain Areiel is weakening Nifflevar with attacks on its dragonflayer defenders before reinforcements arrive from Vengeance Landing. Scribe Seguine, a Vengeance Landing scholar, wants the sagas of the vrykul bard Helgus from Nifflevar before the town is razed.

You are in Lydell's Ambush, a Horde ambush site in Howling Fjord. Lydell lays a trap for the vrykul chieftain Bjorn Halgurdsson, provoking him with an insult and luring him here on the orders of Sergeant Gorth. Vengeance Landing assassins wait in the area, and vrykul corpses are about.

You are in Vengeance Lift, a Horde post in Howling Fjord. Sergeant Gorth directs attacks on the Winterskorn across the blockade and in Baleheim, and he proposes burning the town's buildings and bridges. Longrunner Nanik, a Taunka envoy from Camp Winterhoof, seeks allies against the vrykul, and Apothecary Scyllis of the Royal Apothecary Society is also here. Winterskorn defenders are the danger.
You are in Balejar Watch, a Horde post in Howling Fjord. Winterskorn defenders are in great numbers here, and Oric the Baleful and Ulf the Bloodletter are among the most dangerous vrykul.
You are in Twin Shores, part of Howling Fjord. Reef bulls and reef cows are found along its shores, and a rabid brown bear is the danger here.

You are in Utgarde Keep, an area of Howling Fjord. Explorers' League dwarves work among the relics of the Utgarde Catacombs, and Dragonflayers hold their fellow dwarf Daegarn captive in the Ring of Judgement. Dragonflayer fleshrippers, berserkers and soulreavers roam the catacombs alongside val'kyr overseers.

You are in Valgarde, an Alliance town in Howling Fjord. Innkeeper Hazel Lagras runs its inn, and grand master trainers in cooking, tailoring, alchemy and enchanting work here. Baron Ulrik von Stromhearth of the Kirin Tor offers teleportation to Dalaran, which now floats above Crystalsong Forest.

You are in Westguard Inn, an Alliance inn in Howling Fjord. Innkeeper Celeste Goodhutch offers food and lodging, and Chef Kettleblack, who cooks for the keep, needs shoveltusk meat while livestock keep disappearing. Amateur alchemist Peppy Wrongnozzle tinkers with a mixture meant to counter the Forsaken plague, and shoveltusk stags are dangerous.

You are in Vengeance Landing Inn, a Horde inn at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord. Its innkeeper, Timothy Holland, invites weary travelers to rest, and grand master tailoring trainer Alexandra McQueen offers to teach a way of salvaging frostweave cloth from slain northern humanoids.
